findings.text: import_wp_users updates username and email on a re-run, sets date_joined from user_registered, and temporarily renames usernames to wp-import-<pk hex> to avoid unique-index collisions. R10 only asks for create-once with a mapped role and a verbatim hash. Keep it (it is harmless and supports re-runs) or revert it.
findings.evidence: auth/accounts/wp_import.py import_users: update_or_create defaults={'username','email'}, create_defaults date_joined=wp.registered; parking loop with User.objects.filter(pk=pk).update(username=f'wp-import-{pk.hex}')
